flexible_post_content.text_editor:
A new CDO to help shape the future of technology for O3

O3 has named Mahesh Gaitonde as our new Chief Digital Officer. Formerly of LiquidHub and Capgemini, Mahesh has 20+ years of experience working with digital products and solutions. For our clients, this announcement means they can expect a broader range of innovative products, services and capabilities from O3.

Read the full press release including more on Mahesh’s background and expertise.
